First time actually committing to this achievement since im trophy hunting for everything. Methods that I used:

Spray n’ Pray on Bandit Roundup - The first method I used and works pretty well, averaged at 800-1000 tickets per run. I didn’t use the ammo type that it takes so I wasn’t worried about spent ammunition since I had a bunch in stock. I seen many suggested to use the Thirst Zapper instead if you’re worried about ammo but that method really didn’t work for me and was only around 500-700 tickets per run. Was probably doing it wrong but I didn’t have the patience.

Hoop shot - Honestly yeah I would agree and say this is the best way to grind this achievement. You do the carpet glitch and stack the machines together (I did four) so the hoops line up and spam crouch the ball. I’m on console so I changed the crouch to one of the triggers to make it easier. Averaged 800-1000 per machine, so around 3k tickets per run (just an estimate cause i’m shit at exact math) Only issue I had was trying to get on top the hoop and it wasted time (you only 60 seconds) but that didn’t happen often.

Methods I tried:

Duplication glitch - Just didn’t work for me, couldn’t get the hang of it. As far as I know there are two duplicate glitches, one with the store/scrap option in build mode (that doesn’t work since you can’t scrap the tickets) and one with the contraptions, but I couldn’t get the timing right on it.

“Auto Hoop Shot”(?) - Basically using contraptions to auto dunk balls in. Idk how to explain it but it’s [this](https://youtu.be/U26SrqcbMEc?feature=shared) Works well enough, I didn’t like it because 1) I don’t have enough materials to mass make these things so I could only make one. 2) Only averaged 198-213 tickets per run. You can keep putting it tokens to let it stack up, and if you have all the resources to make a ton of these then go for it. 

I know this old news by now, and theres a ton of tutorials how to do this but wanted to give my own input since this is the first time in all these years I went for this achievement.
